project_context.archetype: High-Contrast Cyber Operations Center (Fusion of E1 Archetype 4 & 7)
project_context.reference_feel: Palantir + Stripe + Vercel + high-end cyber operations center
project_context.core_directive: Dramatic, cinematic, premium-infrastructure full redesign. Must be unrecognizable from the previous version.

constraints.performance: Must render at 60fps on 2020 mid-range phone

visual_atmosphere_brief.lighting: Cinematic and directional. Deep shadows (pure black or #050505) punctuated by sharp, localized neon light bleeds (matrix green/cyan) underneath borders or data points.
visual_atmosphere_brief.typography_hierarchy: Brutalist scale. H1s are massive, tight-tracked, and left-aligned. Data numbers (metrics, nodes) use monospace fonts and are intensely illuminated.
visual_atmosphere_brief.motion_vocabulary: Deliberate, technical, hardware-like. No bouncy spring animations. Use ease-out-expo for drawer opens. Use slow, continuous linear drifts for background beams and topology data packets.
visual_atmosphere_brief.depth_treatment: Optical clarity via glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl on top of dark translucent layers) paired with stark 1px solid borders (border-white/10). Elements feel layered on top of a motherboard, not floating in empty space.
visual_atmosphere_brief.the_palantir_stripe_vercel_factor: Palantir's data-density and stark tension + Stripe's micro-interactions (hover glows, fluid transitions) + Vercel's absolute dark-mode minimalism and typography discipline.

headings.family: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, or General Sans
headings.usage: Use for massive storytelling elements and section headers.

monospace.family: JetBrains Mono, Roboto Mono, or IBM Plex Mono
monospace.usage: Use for live data, telemetry, code snippets, overlines, and labels.

body.usage: Strictly for long-form reading and functional descriptions.

background_system_blueprint.layer_1_grain: CSS noise overlay (mix-blend-overlay, opacity-20) covering the entire viewport.
background_system_blueprint.layer_2_grid: SVG background pattern. 1px line thickness, rgba(255,255,255,0.03), 40px cell size. Fades out at the edges using mask-image: radial-gradient.
background_system_blueprint.layer_3_radial_glows: Absolute positioned divs with massive blur (blur-[120px]), low opacity (10-15%), using --grid-matrix or --grid-violet. Positioned strategically behind key components.
background_system_blueprint.layer_4_moving_beams: Framer Motion animated divs mapping to SVG paths or absolute coordinates, simulating data beams traversing the grid (opacity-50, linear easing).
background_system_blueprint.layer_5_scanlines: Repeating linear gradient (transparent 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 50%) applied via CSS, moving slowly vertically.
background_system_blueprint.css_svg_technique: Combine tailwind classes (`bg-[url(...)]`, `backdrop-blur`) with framer-motion `motion.div` for beams. Avoid heavy canvas. Ensure `pointer-events-none` on all background layers.

large_topology_centerpiece.description: A massive, purely SVG-based interactive data-globe/network-map that dominates the right side (>=40%) of the cinematic hero.
large_topology_centerpiece.geometry: A layered SVG construction. Base is a stylized orthographic or isometric network web (no 3D sphere). Consists of 100+ connected nodes of varying sizes.
large_topology_centerpiece.animation: Framer Motion orchestrates SVG `stroke-dasharray` and `stroke-dashoffset` to create 'data packets' moving along lines. Nodes pulse continuously using standard CSS `@keyframes` scale/opacity.
large_topology_centerpiece.layering: Bottom: Dimmed, static paths. Middle: Highlighted paths indicating active network routes. Top: Glowing circles (nodes) reflecting `verified_active_nodes` telemetry.
large_topology_centerpiece.zero_state: When `verified_active_nodes === 0`, the topology must NOT disappear or look broken. It shifts to an 'AWAITING VERIFIED NODES' state: lines turn amber/gray, pulses slow down, scanning radar animation activates.

scarcity_progress_console.evolution: Transform from a simple 'card' to a massive, full-viewport-width command console panel.
scarcity_progress_console.layout: Bento-style metrics framing a giant central progress element.
scarcity_progress_console.dramatic_element: A large neon progress bar utilizing --grid-matrix. The 1,000,000 target is displayed in massive monospace font (`text-6xl sm:text-8xl`).
scarcity_progress_console.phase_indicator: Step-based timeline above the progress bar showing current epoch/phase, utilizing sharp geometric shapes and glowing active states.

b2b_saas_preview.composition: A high-fidelity visual slice of the customer portal integrated directly into the landing page. Not just a screenshot, but a layered DOM representation or a highly stylized image combined with HTML overlays.
b2b_saas_preview.visual_treatment: Use the provided generated image as the base surface, apply a glassmorphism overlay containing live (or mock) stats fetching from `/api/devices/summary`.
b2b_saas_preview.motion: On scroll-into-view, the interface 'boots up'—charts reveal via masking, numbers count up.

final_cta_wall.composition: Deep, immersive full-screen section. Dark void background.
final_cta_wall.interaction: The CTA button is a complex component: glowing border, matrix-green hover state, trailing light beam. The entire wall reacts to mouse movement via slight background shift.

landing_sections.name: 1. Cinematic Hero
landing_sections.dominant_element: Split View: Massive Typography (Left), Live SVG Topology (Right).
landing_sections.composition_rules: Hero must fill 100vh. Content constrained in a max-w-[1400px] container but visual elements bleed to edge. Topology occupies exactly 40-50% width on desktop.
landing_sections.motion_notes: Staggered fade-up for text. Topology boots sequentially (grid, then lines, then nodes).
landing_sections.do_dont: DO: Use heavy contrast. DON'T: Center the text. DON'T: Overlay text on top of the complex topology.

landing_sections.name: 2. Live Network Command Panel
landing_sections.composition_rules: Full-width dark ribbon crossing the screen. Strict grid layout (cols-4 or cols-6).
landing_sections.motion_notes: Numbers tick continuously. A scanning vertical beam sweeps across the panel.
landing_sections.do_dont: DO: Bind directly to `/api/network/scarcity-progress`. DON'T: Use generic card wrappers.

landing_sections.name: 3. Split-screen Compute-Time Receipt Manifesto
landing_sections.dominant_element: High-contrast text manifesto vs conceptual receipt visual.
landing_sections.composition_rules: 50/50 split. Left: Large manifesto text. Right: A literal 'digital receipt' graphic, built with HTML/CSS, showing hash codes and timestamps.
landing_sections.motion_notes: Receipt prints/scrolls upward slightly on viewport enter.
landing_sections.do_dont: DO: Use monospace font for the receipt. DON'T: Make it look like a blog post.

landing_sections.name: 4. Scarcity Progress Console
landing_sections.composition_rules: Full section width, heavy padding. Integrated into a 'control panel' UI rather than a generic section.
landing_sections.motion_notes: Progress bar animates from 0 to current value over 2.5 seconds. Glow intensifies upon landing.
landing_sections.do_dont: DO: Make the number feel intimidatingly large. DON'T: Hide the progress in a small widget.

landing_sections.name: 5. Premium APK Deployment Module
landing_sections.composition_rules: Terminal-like bento box. Darkest background layer (#000). Features a live QR code and version string from `/api/apk/version`.
landing_sections.motion_notes: QR code pulses. Terminal cursor blinks.
landing_sections.do_dont: DO: Treat the APK like a weapon deployment code. DON'T: Use standard App Store badges (must look like direct infrastructure download).

landing_sections.name: 6. Foundation Buyback Policy Panel
landing_sections.composition_rules: Swiss grid. Highly structured text, stark lines. Fetches from `/api/foundation/buyback-status`.
landing_sections.motion_notes: Hovering over terms highlights them with a sharp 1px border. No soft fades.
landing_sections.do_dont: DO: Use strict, unemotional language. DON'T: Make it look promotional or guaranteed.

landing_sections.name: 7. B2B SaaS Compute Surface Preview
landing_sections.composition_rules: Centered presentation, overflowing the container edges. Floating UI elements.
landing_sections.do_dont: DO: Use the provided generated image. DON'T: Show generic charts.

landing_sections.name: 8. Final CTA Wall
landing_sections.composition_rules: Absolute center layout, negative space dominates.
landing_sections.motion_notes: Button breathes. Background grid moves toward the user (scale animation).
landing_sections.do_dont: DO: Make the button the undeniable focus. DON'T: Add secondary links to this section.

token_sections.name: 1. Hero: TGC is not a coin
token_sections.composition_rules: Left-aligned, filling 80% of screen. Extreme negative space on the right. No imagery.
token_sections.motion_notes: Text enters with a hard, instant reveal (no soft opacity fade).
token_sections.do_dont: DO: Make it a statement of truth. DON'T: Use any crypto imagery.

token_sections.name: 2. Compute-Time Receipt
token_sections.composition_rules: SVG flowchart mapping Energy -> Compute -> Receipt.
token_sections.do_dont: DO: Treat it like a whitepaper diagram brought to life.

token_sections.name: 3. Network Scarcity
token_sections.composition_rules: Grid of locked vs available slots. Deep dark red/amber accents for scarcity.
token_sections.do_dont: DO: Emphasize urgency through data, not marketing copy.

token_sections.name: 4. Radical Scarcity
token_sections.composition_rules: Large SVG line chart spanning the width of the container.
token_sections.motion_notes: Chart draws itself left to right.
token_sections.do_dont: DO: Make the math look rigorous.

token_sections.name: 5. Foundation Buyback
token_sections.composition_rules: Terminal-style readout. Green for ACTIVE window, Amber/Gray for CLOSED.
token_sections.do_dont: DO: Re-use the landing page component style for consistency.

token_sections.name: 6. Milestone Roadmap
token_sections.dominant_element: Vertical timeline with heavy connecting nodes.
token_sections.composition_rules: Left-aligned line. Completed phases are matrix-green. Future phases are wireframe/empty.

token_sections.name: 7. Risk Clarity
token_sections.do_dont: DO: Make it look like a professional prospectus.

anti_patterns: The Bootstrap Standard Layout: Avoid equal-width columns. Asymmetry creates tension. Tension creates interest.

Card-Stacked Dashboard Syndrome: DO NOT wrap every piece of content in a rounded rectangle with a gray background and a drop shadow. Use the grid lines themselves (border-collapse style) or pure negative space.
Muddy Gray Backgrounds: Never use #1a1a1a or #333333. Use pure #000 or extremely dark tinted shades like #050505 to achieve optical depth.
Centered Everything: Centered layouts kill visual momentum. Use strong left alignment paired with heavy visual counterweights on the right.
The Gradient Overload: Do not use full-screen purple-blue generic web3 gradients. Use localized, sharp, blurred neon light spots under text or borders.
Default Inter Headings: Do not use Inter or generic sans-serif for massive H1/H2s. Use fonts with character (Cabinet Grotesk) and extremely tight tracking.
Floating Astronauts/Generic 3D: No irrelevant 3D blobs. The visual system must be strictly tied to topology, infrastructure, and command-line code.
Standard Button Padding: A button shouldn't look like a standard web form submit. It should look like an infrastructure deployment trigger.

acceptance_tests.visual_delta_test: Take a screenshot of the old version. Take a screenshot of the new version. If a non-technical user cannot instantly identify that the entire core layout and visual identity has transformed from a 'SaaS' to a 'Cyber Operations Command Center', the test fails.
acceptance_tests.hero_dominance_test: On desktop (1440px), the SVG Topology right-side element must occupy no less than 40% of the viewport width and feel integrated, not like a pasted image.
acceptance_tests.performance_test: Scroll from top to bottom on a mid-range mobile device profile. Frame rate must remain solid 60fps (ensured by pure SVG and avoiding heavy Three.js canvas).
acceptance_tests.scarcity_console_test: The scarcity section must fill its own container horizontally and act as a commanding focal point, not a secondary metric.

testing_attributes.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

cyber_infrastructure_bg.description: High-end cinematic dark mode cyber infrastructure background. Use for hero or Final CTA background overlays with low opacity.

b2b_saas_preview_mockup.description: Abstract isometric view of a premium B2B SaaS dashboard interface. Use directly in the B2B SaaS Compute Surface section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this document as the absolute truth for the visual redesign.
You must completely gut the existing Landing.jsx and Token.jsx layouts, keeping ONLY the backend bindings and data hooks.
Implement the SVG Topology centerpiece manually using framer-motion and standard SVG paths. Do NOT try to install Three.js or R3F.
Ensure the exact CSS variables and colors defined in the palette section are used.
Do NOT add any new pages, stick to the provided routes.
Inject the provided media URLs directly into your `src` tags or background CSS classes.
